The thinking behind the shelf

How it works

Search across Open Library, choose books you love, and Afterword turns your selections into a transformer-based taste vector. Supabase then retrieves semantically similar books with pgvector before the results are reranked to balance closeness with discovery.

A personal project

About the project

Afterword is a personal recommendation-system project built around semantic search, transformer embeddings and public book metadata. The current version uses Open Library for live search and covers, generates the reader profile in the browser, and retrieves recommendations from a Supabase pgvector catalogue.
